limits: Targeted test sets overlap; these counts are not a full local suite.
PostgreSQL conditional_access tests are ignored slow integration tests compiled locally and assigned to CI.
HTTP refresh authentication age is a controlled seeded grant; browser password and WebAuthn proofs are actual ceremonies.
Stable fuzz smoke checks are not an instrumented coverage campaign.
Device posture remains unavailable until the separate registry and reviewed proof source are implemented.
Authorization completion checks its current snapshot; policy signature fences apply at the selected issuance action. Configure authorize and authorization_code together for both boundaries.
Offline already-issued JWT acceptance lasts until expiry unless a resource enforces online checks or its own revocation integration.
Local verification does not claim a remote CI result.
